title: Cancel a commercial mooring licence
summary: You can cancel your commercial mooring licence at a Service NSW Centre, by post, or by email.
intro:
If you want to cancel your commercial mooring licence, you can do so at a Service NSW Centre or by post or email.

You may be required to remove the mooring apparatus from the seabed and you're responsible for any costs associated with the removal.

For more information visit Transport for NSW.
what_you_need: A written request to cancel the commercial mooring licence on the organisation's letterhead
The PDF form – Request for Refund – Maritime (if applicable)
A letter of authority on organisation letterhead and signed by a director/secretary/president/chairperson of the organisation, authorising you to act on the organisation's behalf

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application in person at a service centre, or by post or email, using the details on the form.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for removing the mooring apparatus?
faqs.a: You are responsible for any costs associated with removing the mooring apparatus from the seabed.

faqs.q: How can I cancel my commercial mooring licence?
faqs.a: You can cancel your licence at a Service NSW Centre, by post, or by email.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about mooring?
faqs.a: For more information, visit Transport for NSW.
